facts.summary: Phase 3 trial missed primary and secondary endpoints, SAD program discontinued, strategic review · Phase 3 · BNC210 in social anxiety disorder · not yet approved

evidence.summary: AFFIRM-1 trial did not meet primary endpoint or secondary endpoints
evidence.primary_endpoint_met: the AFFIRM-1 Phase 3 trial of BNC210 for the acute treatment of social anxiety disorder (SAD) did not meet its primary endpoint
evidence.safety: The safety and tolerability profile of BNC210 continued to be favorable and was consistent with previously reported studies.
evidence.program_discontinued: Neuphoria will discontinue further development of its SAD program.
